URLs here are stored verbatim as the CMS emits them and are never host-rewritten.

_meta.rightsNote: Sermons are the work of the speakers of the church that operates fuyindiantai.org. Use in this app was authorised by the church. Per-sermon credit is the record's `author`; where `author` is null, or `authorKind` is "programme", the credit is to 福音电台.
_meta.authorisedBy: Repo owner (Paul Liu), relaying the church. Recorded verbatim from his instruction of 2026-08-09: 「他们都是我们教会牧师做的有批准所以safe to use」 — the sites are run by his own church's pastors and are approved for use. That statement was made about the SONGS on the same two domains; the sermon library on the same WordPress install was directed on 2026-09-05 (「我要你全部做」). This field records who said what and when, not a signed licence — if a written grant exists, replace this with a pointer to it.
_meta.suspectDateNote: These records carry an upstream `date` this script could not accept (unparseable, or a year outside 1980–present). The value is stored verbatim and flagged `dateSuspect`; nothing is inferred or repaired. Date-ordered views should sort a flagged record as undated rather than trusting the value.
_meta.authorisedScopeNote: Songs authorisation is direct and explicit. Sermon authorisation is inherited from the same source and the same speakers, and was not restated in those words. Worth confirming with the church before any public release that redistributes 940 sermon bodies and 673 audio files.
